name: Sketches of of figures at foodstalls, and a figure smoking a pipe
summary: Studies of vendors and diners at a Macau street market, with a separate drawing of a turbanned man smoking a long-stemmed pipe, while a shallow basket of produce lies at his feet; above is a further study of his arm and hand.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
